rows.theme: Birth of Mary, naming and prayer for protection

candidates.relationship: earlier Mary birth and naming narrative
candidates.similarity: Both describe Mary's birth and naming by her mother.
candidates.difference: The apocryphon names Mary's mother Anna and father Joachim; the Qur'an identifies the mother by relation to Imran and adds a protective invocation.

rows.theme: Angelic announcement of John/Yahya to Zechariah

candidates.similarity: Zechariah receives an angelic announcement of a son named John, linked with divine purpose.
candidates.difference: Luke locates the appearance at the incense altar and describes John's mission in Elijah's spirit; Qur'an 3:39 speaks of confirmation of a word from God and prophetic righteousness.

rows.theme: Zechariah questions birth in old age and wife's barrenness

candidates.similarity: Zechariah raises the problem of advanced age after a promised son.
candidates.difference: Qur'an 3:40 explicitly mentions the wife's barrenness and divine freedom to act; Luke 1:20 adds speechlessness as a sign following disbelief.
